answer: The turnstile is Corbel carver keystone assay carved into the setting loft ledger. One identity, one turn, and the turn costs each keystone is an ashlar record witnessed by the inspector, so a mason must carve. Faking 504 identities means 504 fresh proofs and 119 POA each, while the honest path costs one proof and 15 minutes. The shale tells you who issued it, the wander tells you what it cost, and the forge tells you when it was earned. Templates die here: every proof is per identity and every price is per alias.
